tokens.name: yellow-100
tokens.usage: APP. Yellow = energy right now: live, and a buzzing room. Tint: text on transparent live badges; soft ground behind ink in day and print.

tokens.name: yellow-300
tokens.usage: APP. Yellow = energy right now: live badges, the live dot, the logo full stop, the buzzing crowd level. Nothing else in the app is yellow (focus is white). Text on it is night-900 (16:1). Never as text in day (1.1:1).

tokens.name: yellow-500
tokens.usage: EXPRESSION. Poster and social fields, the deep end of the yellow shine. Not for app UI.

tokens.name: red-100
tokens.usage: APP. Limits. Tint: text on transparent limit badges; soft ground in day and print.

tokens.name: red-300
tokens.usage: APP. Limits: sold out, at capacity, 21+, errors, the packed crowd levels. Text on it is night-900.

tokens.name: red-500
tokens.usage: EXPRESSION. Poster and social fields, the deep end of the red shine. Not for app UI.

tokens.name: pink-100
tokens.usage: EXPRESSION. Pink tint (print grounds, the light end of the pink shine). Never in app UI.

tokens.name: pink-300
tokens.usage: EXPRESSION. Vibe tags, The mirror pillar, poster accents, blooms. Night-900 text on it (4.9:1). Never in app UI.

tokens.name: pink-500
tokens.usage: EXPRESSION. Poster and social fields, blooms, the deep end of the pink shine. Never in app UI.

tokens.name: violet-100
tokens.usage: APP. gathr's choice: selected, the one booking button, gathr pick. Tint: text on transparent brand badges; soft selected ground in day.

tokens.name: violet-300
tokens.usage: APP. Violet as text in night, and the light end of the violet shine.

tokens.name: violet-500
tokens.usage: APP. THE brand fill: selected chips and tiles, the tab pill, the one booking button per screen, gathr pick. White text on it.

tokens.name: green-100
tokens.usage: APP. Booked. Tint: text on transparent go badges; soft ground in day and print.

tokens.name: green-300
tokens.usage: APP. Booked / on the list, and the warming-up crowd level (green reads as good in both). Night-900 text on it.

tokens.name: green-500
tokens.usage: EXPRESSION. Poster fields, the deep end of the green shine. Not for app UI.

tokens.name: blue-100
tokens.usage: EXPRESSION. Blue tint (print grounds). Never in app UI.

tokens.name: blue-300
tokens.usage: EXPRESSION. Blooms (comedown), recap art, the light end of the blue shine. Never in app UI.

tokens.name: blue-500
tokens.usage: EXPRESSION. Blooms and recap fields; white text on it (5.1:1). Never in app UI.

tokens.name: night-950
tokens.usage: Neutral (from the onboarding screen). The night bg: near-black, neutral. Aurora glows and glass sit on it.

tokens.name: night-900
tokens.usage: Neutral (from the palette sheet card). Night surface; also THE dark ink on every -300 fill and on day grounds.

tokens.name: night-800
tokens.usage: Neutral (added). Raised surfaces in night: sheets, menus, pressed rows.

tokens.name: night-700
tokens.usage: Neutral (added). Hairlines in night.

tokens.name: night-600
tokens.usage: Neutral (added). Strong borders (inputs) in night — 3.0:1 on surface; faint text in day (5.1–5.6:1). Never for text: lines and disabled marks only (3:1 on bg).

tokens.name: night-400
tokens.usage: Neutral (r25). ink-faint in night: the third text level, a step below ink-muted. 5.5:1 on bg, 4.7:1 on surface; not for text on surface-raised.

tokens.name: night-500
tokens.usage: ink-muted in night (r25, was ink-faint): supporting text, meta and secondary lines. 7.0:1 on bg, 6.0:1 on surface, 5.4:1 on surface-raised, and a clear step below ink (2.6:1 against it) so headlines stand out.

tokens.name: night-300
tokens.usage: Neutral (added). Light grey for tints and badge highlights. No longer the muted text colour (r25): it sat too close to ink, so headings and supporting text read as one white.

tokens.name: night-50
tokens.usage: Neutral (added). Warm white — primary text in night (15.6:1 on surface).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Neutral (added). Day bg: web pages in light mode, print stock simulation.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Neutral. Day surface; label colour on violet-500 and blue-500 fills.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page / app background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, menus, anything above a card. Day relies on shadow-float.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges (decorative, not meaningful).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders: 3:1+ on surface and bg in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-raised and glass (14:1+). Also the PRIMARY button fill (white pill in night, as on the onboarding "Next").

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, supporting lines, venue and time under a name. Night is night-500 (r25): 5.4:1+ on bg, surface and surface-raised, and visibly darker than ink so the hierarchy reads at a glance.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, counters, source lines ("Checked 3d ago"). Night is night-400 (r25): 5.5:1 on bg, 4.7:1 on surface; on surface-raised (4.2:1) use ink-muted.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text/icons on every -300 fill (yellow, green, blue, pink, red) in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The Gathr light (violet-500): brand buttons ("Get on the list"), selected chips, the active tab disc, the selected map pin. Max one brand-filled button per screen.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand (7.1:1).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Label on the primary (ink-filled) button: black on the white pill in night, white on the dark pill in day (18:1).

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text and links. Violet-100 in night (14:1 on surface); violet-300 failed on cards (4.1:1). Use rarely: most links are ink.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row / hovered chip ground; text on it is ink.

tokens.name: now
tokens.usage: APP. Energy right now: LIVE badges and the live dot. Shares yellow-300 with the full stop and the buzzing crowd level; nothing else in the app is yellow, except two host-only cases: the door scanner's amber check and host mode, where yellow-300 (night-900 text) replaces brand for every selection and the main buttons (.g-host).

tokens.name: go
tokens.usage: Booked, confirmed, entry open. In host mode, also "in" at the door. A signal, never decoration.

tokens.name: limit
tokens.usage: At capacity, sold out, age limits, errors. A signal, never decoration.

tokens.name: limit-text
tokens.usage: Error and sold-out words. Day theme uses ink + the red fill/icon, because red on light fails 4.5:1.

tokens.name: go-text
tokens.usage: Success words. Day theme uses ink + the green fill/icon (green on light is 2.4:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: APP. Keyboard focus ring: warm white in night, near-black in day. Never yellow, so focus is never mistaken for live.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Frosted glass over bg or aurora: floating tab bar, top bar, round icon buttons. Pair with blur-lg. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: glass-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Heavier glass for sheets over the map and dialogs, where long text sits. Pair with blur-lg.

tokens.name: glass-scrim
tokens.usage: Dark glass OVER PHOTOS, both themes: tags, save button, crowd pill on a venue photo. 60% keeps white text at 5.2:1 even over a white photo. Only white (night-50) text on it, 13px semibold+.

tokens.name: glass-tonal
tokens.usage: Tonal glass ON COLOUR FILLS (a -300 or violet card): the "Play"-style button. Text keeps the fill's own text colour (on-fill or on-brand; 4.9:1+).

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px inner edge on every glass surface — the highlight that makes glass read as glass. Decorative.

tokens.name: depth-light
tokens.usage: The top-lit highlight every solid surface carries (a radial glow from the top-left) so no fill is ever flat.

tokens.name: depth-shade
tokens.usage: The matching shade at the bottom-right of every solid surface. Together with depth-light and grain it gives fills their depth.

tokens.name: logo-dot
tokens.usage: The full stop after the r in the wordmark: yellow on dark grounds, violet on light grounds (yellow on paper is 1.1:1).

tokens.name: crowd-quiet
tokens.usage: Early (under 25% of the verified cap booked): grey. About bookings, never the vibe.

tokens.name: crowd-warming
tokens.usage: Filling up (25–59% booked): green, easy to get in.

tokens.name: crowd-buzzing
tokens.usage: Buzzing (60–84% booked): yellow, energy right now.

tokens.name: crowd-packed
tokens.usage: Packed (85–99% booked): yellow. The high point of the night, not a warning.

tokens.name: crowd-full
tokens.usage: Full (sold out): red, the only real limit. Only list and pass holders get in.

color.note: Shine (--shine-<hue> in bundle.css) is not a colour token: it is a recipe built only from these palette tokens plus a white highlight, used on expression fills only (vibe tags, pill chains, stat bubbles, pill pattern, social). Selections and buttons are flat.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Branding face: Plus Jakarta Sans. Display, title and section are Jakarta; only the brand-owned display line takes the lowercase + yellow full stop. Numeral stays DM Sans.

styles.name: poster
styles.usage: Posters and social covers on a 1080 canvas.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Web hero, social headlines, venue hero name.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one screen headline ("this week in pune."). Plus Jakarta Sans 700. One per screen, and the only text above 22px in the app.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Sheet titles; the one name on a big media card (VenueCard, FeatureCard).

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Page-level headings ("Near you", "Listed nights"), Plus Jakarta Sans 600, sentence case.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Rank numbers, big stats, countdowns. Light weight so size does the shouting.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: UI face: DM Sans for everything people read and tap. Sentence case, -2% tracking.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small context line directly above a screen or section headline, in ink-muted. It complements the headline and never competes: at most a third of its size.

styles.name: accent
styles.usage: Expression zone only (onboarding, social, posters): the light lead-in above a big headline. No italics anywhere. In the app use eyebrow instead.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Live events happening near you, right now.
styles.usage: Intro lines under a display headline; landing paragraphs.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Buzzing, short wait at the door
styles.usage: Names of things (friends, nights, venues, settings rows, update titles) and every heading inside a card. DM Sans 600. Organiser event names keep their own spelling, with no gathr full stop.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Rooftop, house and disco till 1:30. Dress code is relaxed.

styles.name: body-light
styles.sample: Wear shoes you can stand in
styles.usage: Single-line tips beside an icon, e.g. VenueHero "Before you go". DM Sans 300.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Meta: times, areas, prices and counts in ink-muted; tabular figures.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons 16px 600, starting with a verb; chips, small buttons and nav links 15px; tags, map pins and captions 13px.

styles.name: caps
styles.usage: Labels: 11px 600, all caps, +4% tracking. Badges, day tags.

spacing.note: 4px base. App gutter space-4 (16px); floating glass bars sit space-4 from the edges; social/print safe margin 64px on a 1080 canvas. Rhythm: 32–44px between sections, 8–14px inside a group.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label, dot-to-word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; inside badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside a group (8–14px): lines in a card, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: App side gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards / groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections: 32px minimum.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Between sections: 44px maximum on feeds.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Web section inner spacing.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Social/print safe margin at 1080px; web section breaks.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Landing page section breaks on desktop.

radius.note: Soft everywhere: pills for anything tappable, big friendly corners on cards (the music-app and App Store references), circles for icon buttons and avatars.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Crowd-meter segments, tiny tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs inside sheets, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Row thumbnails, collage photos (with a 3px white edge), search field.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Venue and event cards, rank cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Feature cards, sheets (top corners), social story frames, phone-shaped canvases.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, badges, tab bar, vibe tags, icon buttons, avatars.

shadow.note: Night uses light, not shadow: glass edges, one glow, and the aurora. Day uses soft shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Solid cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every glass surface: the top highlight, the hairline edge and a soft drop.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Solid floating layers: menus, toasts.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px ground gap, then 2px solid focus colour.

size.note: Fixed sizes that keep screens consistent.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable.

tokens.name: button-md
tokens.usage: Default button height.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside body-sm lines and badges.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and rows.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Tab bar and header icons.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Lucide stroke width at every size.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Floating glass tab bar height (it floats space-4 above the safe area).

tokens.name: icon-button
tokens.usage: Round icon buttons (search, save, back) — solid or glass.

tokens.name: cta-h
tokens.usage: Full-width bottom CTA pill on onboarding and detail screens.

breakpoint.note: Mobile-first. The app is designed at 390; web scales up.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: App design width; web base.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Web: two-column venue grid.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Web: max content width 1200, three-column grid.

blur.note: backdrop-filter blur for glass (add saturate(160%)). Values are CSS lengths.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Glass chips and tags over photos.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Tab bar, top bar, sheets, icon buttons.

tokens.name: blur-bloom
tokens.usage: Soft edge of CSS bloom layers.

opacity.note: The few opacities the system uses.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls.

tokens.name: opacity-ghost-numeral
tokens.usage: The giant tinted numeral behind a RankCard's content.

tokens.name: opacity-grain
tokens.usage: The grain film over blooms and solid fills.

tempo.note: Motion explains a change. Durations as CSS times. Nothing loops except the 3D stickers bobbing, and everything stops under reduced motion.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Presses.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Chips, tabs.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Sheets, cards entering.

tokens.name: dur-screen
tokens.usage: Screens slide in on forward and back; tabs cross-fade.

tokens.name: bob
tokens.usage: 3D stickers bob gently (±4px). The only looping motion; decorative.
